title: Loop is not executing
body:
I had this problem before.  I have built new app from scratch and I still have this problem.  Loop works fine at first and then doesn't execute.  Bg is changing and loop doesn't respond for 10 -15 min. This happened lots of times today . 
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UJWREu0WNm5X6Rf0__SVxTKwBYPfjpZk/view?usp=drivesdk

comments.body: i need exact time(s) when this happened

At 21:30 loop was not executing.  I didn't note other times but at some
point it was not working for 10.min ( bg was changing ) then it worked
again once or twice and again ..
